    About Me

    Hi, I’m Dan. I write software for a living and tinker with it for fun.

    I’m a software engineering graduate from the University of Ottawa (completed coursework Dec 2023, conferred 2024) with 4+ years of full stack experience across AWS microservices, React frontends, and everything in between. I like problems that look messy on the surface and clean up nicely once you find the right abstraction.

    Outside of work you’ll catch me on a Wayland tiling window manager, building a side project, or reading something far away from a keyboard.

    Thanks for visiting — say hi if anything here resonates.
